headline: Weekend Preview · June 5–7: Peddi's ₹350 Cr Gamble, David Dhawan's Farewell, and Obsession's Strange Run
dek: Ram Charan opens with $1.1M+ in North America presales into the summer's most crowded Hollywood weekend. Varun Dhawan headlines David Dhawan's final film; Bobby Deol's Bandar fights for screens. Obsession nears $170M on a $750K budget despite a 38-second CBFC cut. BCM hype index, opening predictions and the week's OTT Top 10.
